class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []

        self.has_changed_calls = []

        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:

class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):

            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'

        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):

        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix

        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))

            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")


class NoCssForm(DummyForm):
    @property
    def required_css_class(self):
        raise AttributeError("required_css_class")

    @property
    def error_css_class(self):
        raise AttributeError("error_css_class")

class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

        if self._has_changed_func:

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'

            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'

        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return self._to_python_func(value)

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):

class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):

            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'

            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/textarea.html":

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []

        for key in order:

                elif value is False or value is None:

                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)

            elif value is False or value is None:

            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":

            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'

            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)
